evidence.quote: We propose $30 million paid automatically to the identified class members, with $5 million in fees and expenses separately subject to court approval.

We can reduce our fee-and-expense request to your proposed $3.5 million and move the class fund to $25 million, for a $28.5 million aggregate ceiling. This leaves just $500,000 above your latest offer, all for the class.

summary: Plaintiff counsel raised fees alongside class relief in the opening proposal, and both amounts remained under negotiation until settlement. Hargrove expressly linked its reduced fee request to a proposal whose remaining increase was entirely for the class. The record does not show counsel sacrificing class recovery for its fees, defense exploiting fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
